name: Roland TR-909
description: Classic analog and sample-based MIDI rhythm composer.

documentation.title: Roland TR-909: manufacturer or original documentation

notice: Connect the original TR-909 through DIN MIDI. Configure MIDI receive channel and sync source on the hardware. Instrument tuning and decay knobs are not generic MIDI CCs. Drum-note assignments and clock transport are omitted from this initial profile; consult the MIDI chart. This is not the TR-09 reissue. For computer use, connect MIDI OUT to interface MIDI IN; connect interface MIDI OUT to hardware MIDI IN when controlling the instrument. Port names are intentionally empty: interface or app names do not reliably identify the attached hardware. Select this profile manually. This is partial coverage, not a complete MIDI implementation. The panel is an original schematic; virtual keyboard note numbers are illustrative and require MIDI learn or octave adjustment.
